extracted.name: Frozen piña colada
extracted.description: Take just three ingredients and made our tropical frozen piña colada cocktail. This easy, refreshing slushie is perfect for long, lazy summer afternoons
instruction_lines: Pour the pineapple juice into an ice cube tray and freeze until solid. Pour the white rum into a blender. Add the coconut cream and the pineapple ice cubes and blend together. Pour into tall glasses to serve and garnish with pineapple chunks.
